author: Scott Manley
description:
Manufacturing In Microgravity is a potential business model who's time may have arrived, there are a number of products like pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and optical materials which can be made to higher qualities when the process is carried out in the absence of gravity, so let's explain why this works and what kind of processes can be improved in orbit.
